items.stem: A seller's reported revenue does not match the bank payout. Which data must be reconciled to explain the difference most directly?

options.text: Financial events such as fees, refunds and adjustments
options.rationale: Correct: payouts reflect order totals net of fees, refunds and adjustments.
Images do not affect payout amounts.
Keywords affect discovery, not payout reconciliation.
Time zone alone does not explain a revenue-to-payout gap.

items.explanation: Correct: payouts reflect order totals net of fees, refunds and adjustments.

items.stem: Which TWO practices help a Selling Partner integration stay reliable under API quotas? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Respect rate limits and apply exponential backoff on throttling
options.rationale: Correct: backoff keeps the integration within quotas.

options.text: Monitor account health and request status
options.rationale: Correct: monitoring catches throttling and account issues early.

options.text: Send as many requests as fast as possible
Ignore error responses and retry immediately in a tight loop

items.explanation: Correct: both keyed options are right; the distractors are wrong for the reasons given.

items.stem: Which statement best describes access to Selling Partner API data?

options.text: A selling partner authorizes an application to act on the account's data
options.rationale: Correct: access is granted through a selling-partner authorization, not a personal login.

options.text: Anyone can read any seller's data without authorization
Access requires no credentials at all
Data is only available by email request
options.rationale: Data is retrieved programmatically under authorization.

items.explanation: Correct: access is granted through a selling-partner authorization, not a personal login.
